sample_unit: patients undergoing outpatient CT or MRI

links.outcome: Patient preference for being informed of AI use in their imaging care, and self-rated AI knowledge
links.effect: 90.3% (204/226) believed they should be informed about AI use in their care; 67.4% (151/224) reported minimal to no AI knowledge. Authors note a discrepancy between patient preferences and current clinical practice.
links.quote: 90.3% (204/226) believed they should be informed about the use of AI in their care, and 91.1% (204/224) supported the right to opt out.

screen.reason: This is a cross-sectional survey evaluating patient perceptions, knowledge, and preferences regarding disclosure and use of AI in medical imaging. It does not test or compare specific deployment practices.
